merturl4576-unflat-unflat.description: Use when a website or landing page looks flat - one background color across the whole page, every section on the same plane, nothing reads as a separate block while scrolling (worst on a phone). Also use when asked to frame or ground a site's sections, give a page depth, texture or atmosphere, make a dark or light background less boring, or to "unflat" a page. For marketing and content pages built with plain CSS, Tailwind, CSS modules or CSS-in-JS; not for app dashboards.
